thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'inference-west-1' queue length 21,482; avg queue growth ~800 req/s over 12m. Autoscaler failed to scale above 32 nodes. Pager: @alice_oncall

alice (oncall): Acked. Paging now; looking into autoscaler logs.

ben (sre): I'm on. Give me root outputs: `kubectl get gpupool inference-west-1 -o yaml` and `rctl autoscaler status`.

alice (oncall): pasting excerpts:
```
gpupool.inference-west-1:
  max_replicas: 32
  current_replicas: 32
  pending_requests: 21482
autoscaler status:
  controller_state: healthy
  scale_attempts: throttled_by_cloud_qps (429)
  last_error: "rate limit exceeded while creating instances"
```

carla (platform): FYI we lowered autoscaler cloud API QPS to 200/s in last week's policy change (security quota). That might explain the throttles.

dave (eng-runtime): Customer impact check: we're seeing increased latencies and some streaming stalls, plus 503s for queued requests. @eve can you confirm tickets?

eve (customer-success): Confirmed. Multiple tickets for slow responses and timeouts. Impacted tenants flagged: acme-corp, brightpay. CS is sending initial comms.

alice (oncall): Mitigation plan (live):
  1) Manually add burst nodes to inference-west-1 to get above 32 asap.
  2) Flip fallback routing to quantized / smaller model for best-effort traffic.
  3) Apply temporary stricter rate-limits on non-SLA tiers to preserve capacity for paid customers.
  4) Restart autoscaler controller once burst nodes are allocated.

ben (sre): running add nodes now: 
```bash
rctl pool add-nodes --pool inference-west-1 --count 16 --reason "incident 1785123456 burst nodes"
# => success: added 16 nodes; target_replicas: 48
```

carla (platform): I'll restart the autoscaler controller once capacity is visible. Doing `kubectl rollout restart deployment/autoscaler-controller -n infra`.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: restart autoscaler-controller v3.2.1 initiated by carla.

alice (oncall): Restart complete. Autoscaler reports cloud API errors dropping; some 429s still but decreasing. Queue length trending: 21,482 -> 3,412 in ~12 minutes.

dave (eng-runtime): Enabled fallback routing for best-effort traffic (30%):
```
route-policy set inference-west-1 --fallback-model gpt-small-quant --pct 30 --reason "incident 1785123456 preserve SLA"
```

eve (customer-success): Notified impacted customers with interim status and offered priority support. No legal/enterprise escalations so far.

ben (sre): Preliminary root-cause notes: autoscaler had an outdated hard cap of 32 replicas (safety knob from early days). Combined with lowered cloud API QPS the controller could not request sufficient capacity quickly -> queue growth and throttling. Cloud API rate limits returned 429s on instance create calls.

carla (platform): Action taken: increased pool max_replicas to 64 and removed hard cap; requested temporary quota bump from cloud provider; restarting controller fixed current state.

alice (oncall): Handoff: I'm going offline in ~40m. Ben, take primary for RCA and postmortem. Leaving runbook note and logs.

ben (sre): Taking over. I'll open the incident ticket (INC-2026-045) and start the RCA timeline.

carla (platform): Post-incident action items (initial):
  - [P1] Remove implicit hard caps in autoscaler config; make them explicit and documented. Owner: carla. ETA: 1 week.
  - [P1] Add autoscaler metric for cloud-API-429 rate and alert at 50/s. Owner: ben. ETA: 48h.
  - [P2] Re-evaluate QPS policy that lowered autoscaler QPS; add exception for autoscaler pipeline. Owner: infra team. ETA: 2w.
  - [P2] Add canary/chaos test for autoscaler under quota stress. Owner: dave. ETA: 3w.
  - [P3] Update runbook with manual burst node steps and fallback routing commands. Owner: alice. ETA: 72h.
  - [P3] Customer comms template for capacity incidents. Owner: eve. ETA: 72h.

dave (eng-runtime): Also: add a temporary automated fallback that reduces per-request concurrency for non-SLA tenants when queue > 5k. Owner: dave. ETA: 1w.

alice (oncall): Closing real-time mitigation. Moving conversation to postmortem thread INC-2026-045-postmortem once ben creates it. If anything regresses @channel, ping here. :thumbsup:

ben (sre): Logged initial timeline and assigned owners in INC-2026-045. Will schedule RCA meeting tomorrow.
